description: A dense cluster of brass and black gears interlocks on a dark iron machine frame, with a long paper tape punched with rows of holes winding through the wheels. Smoke or steam rises from pipes at the top and left. The background is a dim industrial interior with faint shelving or structures. No people, no soldiers, no landscape. The only lettering-like mark is a small sparkle logo in the bottom-right corner. The painting fills the image edge to edge.
reason: Shows a brass gear machine with a punched paper tape, but the card is the Peninsular War: no soldiers, no war, no Spain or Napoleon. The picture is an unrelated mechanism.
